cohort: 541 pregnant women presenting for spontaneous labor, induction of labor, or elective cesarean section.
finding: There was no significant difference in psychological disturbance scores between women who had vaginal deliveries, instrumental deliveries, emergency cesarean sections, or elective cesarean sections during the peripartum period.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in psychological disturbance scores between women who had different modes of delivery during the peripartum period.
